title_zh: 芬蘭 RCT：學校篩檢 + 10 週網上兒童焦慮 CBT，兩年後效果仍在
title_en: Internet CBT for child anxiety two-year RCT
summary_zh: 芬蘭圖爾庫大學透過學校健康篩檢，招募 465 名有焦慮症狀的 10–13 歲兒童進行隨機對照試驗。介入組接受 10 週網上認知行為治療「Master Your Worries」，包含兒童與家長模組及每週電話指導；焦慮症狀與功能改善均優於對照組，效果在 6 至 12 個月間更明顯，並延續至兩年追蹤，症狀較重者獲益最大。研究刊於《JAMA Network Open》。
summary_en: A University of Turku RCT of 465 school-screened Finnish children aged 10–13 found a 10-week guided internet CBT programme with parent involvement and weekly phone coaching reduced anxiety and improved functioning, with effects lasting two years (JAMA Network Open).
evidence_note: 隨機對照試驗（新聞稿轉述，刊於 JAMA Network Open）。

posts.title: Finnish intervention program reduces children's anxiety and improves functional ability — effects are still evident after two years
posts.content: 芬蘭圖爾庫大學的隨機對照試驗，以學校健康篩檢找出 465 名 10–13 歲有焦慮症狀的兒童，10 週網上 CBT 課程「Master Your Worries」加家長參與與每週電話指導，兩年後效果仍在，刊於 JAMA Network Open。

related.title_zh: Anna Freud 的校本 CBT 計畫 MindWorks 進入 30 間學校做 RCT
related.title_en: Anna Freud's MindWorks school CBT programme enters RCT
related.summary_zh: MindWorks 是 Anna Freud 開發、以系統取向為基礎的 CBT 計畫，對象為 11–16 歲學生，由受訓的教育心理健康從業員等在一個學期內提供，並把家長與學校職員納入。計畫由 Youth Endowment Fund 資助，2026 年 9 月起在英格蘭 30 間主流與另類學校推行，Ending Youth Violence Lab 以 720 名兒童進行隨機對照試驗。
related.summary_en: MindWorks, a systemic CBT programme for 11–16-year-olds developed by Anna Freud, launches in 30 English schools from September 2026 and is being evaluated in an RCT of 720 children by the Ending Youth Violence Lab.

related.title_zh: 香港教育局澄清謠言：列出學童精神健康到校支援人手與措施
related.title_en: Hong Kong EDB school mental health support clarification
related.summary_zh: 教育局指社交媒體流傳「拒增派到校支援人手」的說法全無事實根據，並列出現行支援：所有公營普通中小學設校本教育心理服務，取錄較多 SEN 學生的學校享教育心理學家與學校 1:4 的「優化服務」，以及小學一校一社工、中學一校兩社工。局方亦提到 2025 年 12 月起中學恆常化「三層應急機制」與 2026/27 學年的新計劃。
related.summary_en: Hong Kong's Education Bureau rebutted claims it refused extra on-site support staff, listing school-based educational psychology services (1:4 ratio for schools with more SEN students), school social workers, and the three-tier emergency mechanism made regular in secondary schools from December 2025.

related.title_zh: ADHD 兒童用藥 RCT：右旋安非他命與哌醋甲酯療效相近，體重變化有差
related.title_en: Dexamphetamine vs methylphenidate in children RCT
related.summary_zh: 澳洲一項開放標籤隨機對照試驗納入 100 名首次用藥的 ADHD 兒童，追蹤 12 個月，比較右旋安非他命（dexamphetamine）與哌醋甲酯（methylphenidate）。兩者都令 ADHD 症狀大幅改善且無顯著差異，身高增長亦無差別；但右旋安非他命組頭三個月平均減重 1.4 公斤，哌醋甲酯組約 300 克。研究刊於《Journal of Paediatrics and Child Health》。
related.summary_en: An open-label RCT of 100 treatment-naive children with ADHD found dexamphetamine and methylphenidate similarly effective over 12 months with no height difference, but greater early weight loss on dexamphetamine (1.4 kg vs 300 g).
